verdicts.decision_note: The client includes necessary load calculations in the additional project's permit-ready drawing scope.
The freelancer explicitly questions whether the newly stated calculations are included, creating material scope uncertainty.

The client confirms calculations needed for the drawings but does not materially change the previously introduced electrical-calculation requirement; Manual J/S/D belongs to the separate HVAC-calculation behavior.
The client directly resolves the freelancer's uncertainty by confirming that required calculations must be performed.
